research_question: Which machine-native memory/query structures can improve Frank v0.1 without allowing learned/opaque mechanisms to become truth or effect authority?

evidence.finding: Indexes can be modeled as learned functions and can improve speed/memory on compatible distributions; applicability is distribution-dependent.
evidence.use: supports learned addressers as candidates, not correctness authority

evidence.finding: A learned layer can steer an existing query optimizer and adapt without replacing all deterministic optimizer mechanics.
evidence.use: supports learned router over deterministic plans

evidence.finding: Guarantees require explicit backup/sandwich paths; recent learned LSM work reports zero-false-negative mode only with backup filters while an aggressive classifier can introduce false negatives.
evidence.use: hard rule: approximate/learned path must abstain/fallback

evidence.finding: Product keys enable fast exact nearest-neighbor addressing into very large structured memories.

evidence.source: Titans arXiv:2501.00663; Memory Layers at Scale arXiv:2412.09764; PRECOG arXiv:2608.02560
evidence.finding: Model-native persistent/sparse/hidden-state memories can add large capacity or reduce context ingestion, but mechanisms depend strongly on model architecture.
evidence.use: candidate model-side memory plane only; never canonical DB truth

evidence.finding: Rich queries can be transformed into incremental maintenance programs.
Merkle inclusion and consistency proofs efficiently bind entries to append-only tree history.
evidence.use: supports periodic authenticated epoch/checkpoint proofs without blockchain

evidence.finding: Popular graph ANN implementations can have linear empirical query behavior on constructed worst-case instances.
evidence.use: forces workload/OOD/adversarial fallback tests before ANN routing promotion

synthesis: The recurring externally supported design pattern is learned steering/addressing with deterministic guarantee/fallback layers. This matches local evidence: PKM is excellent on its manifold and catastrophically wrong off it.
